source_gaps: Google Messages pages were read through WebFetch, which returns a summary, so excerpts and step wording were checked against that output only, not against the raw page HTML. Apple's group iMessage naming, leaving or adding people, and the MMS spam steps were on the page or linked but are not used. Android add-people and rename steps and the RCS tag check were read but not planned.

source_refs.title: Send a group text message on your iPhone or iPad
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Open Messages and tap the Compose button.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Open Messages and tap the Compose button. 2. Enter the names, or tap the Add button to add people from your contacts. 3. Type your message, then tap the Send button.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; steps copied from the section named above as returned by WebFetch; excerpt quoted from that output; platform prefix added

source_refs.title: Send a group text message on your iPhone or iPad
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; iOS 18 for the RCS line
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If any recipient isn't using iMessage, the message is sent as MMS or SMS.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: If all recipients use Apple devices and iMessage is on, the group message is sent as an iMessage. If any recipient isn't using iMessage, the message is sent as MMS or SMS. On iOS 18 or iPadOS 18, RCS is also possible.

source_refs.title: Send a group text message on your iPhone or iPad
source_refs.section: Send a group text message (MMS Messaging setting, narrower fetch)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If you don't see an option to turn on MMS Messaging, contact your carrier to see if your plan supports Group MMS Messaging.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Open the Settings app. 2. Tap Apps. 3. Tap Messages. 4. Turn on MMS Messaging. If you don't see an option to turn on MMS Messaging, contact your carrier to see if your plan supports Group MMS Messaging.

source_refs.title: Explore group conversations in Google Messages
source_refs.section: Change how you send group messages
source_refs.applicability: Android phone with Google Messages; the page does not give a version
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Choose mass text or group MMS as your default.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android phone: 1. Open Google Messages. 2. Tap your profile photo or icon, then 'Messages settings,' then 'Advanced,' then 'Group messaging.' 3. Choose mass text or group MMS as your default.

source_refs.title: Fix problems sending, receiving, or connecting to Google Messages
source_refs.applicability: Google Messages on Android and web
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Tap Send an MMS reply to all recipients (group MMS) to keep group messages in one thread.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android phone: 1. Open Google Messages. 2. Tap your Profile picture or Initials, then Messages settings, then Advanced. 3. Tap Group messaging. 4. Tap Send an MMS reply to all recipients (group MMS) to keep group messages in one thread.
